title: Invoice Sync Failures
content: If invoice sync fails, first try reconnecting the integration. If it fails again, try clearing the cache. If both fail, escalate to tier 2 for manual DB sync.

title: Duplicate Charges
content: Duplicate charges occur when the payment gateway sends two webhooks. Refund the duplicate via Stripe dashboard.

title: Tax Settings Incorrect
content: Ensure regional tax compliance is enabled in Settings > Tax. Manual override is needed for EU VAT.

title: Login/SSO Issues
content: SSO failures are usually due to expired SAML certificates. Request a new cert from the IT admin.

title: API Rate Limits
content: Standard rate limit is 100 req/min. Can be temporarily increased for Enterprise customers upon request.

title: Export Errors (CSV)
content: CSV exports fail if data contains unescaped commas. Recommend using JSON export as a workaround.

title: Refund Processing Error
content: Refunds may fail if the original charge is older than 90 days. Require manual wire transfer.

title: QuickBooks Specific Sync
content: QuickBooks requires matching chart of accounts. Sync will fail if an account is deleted in QB.
